run_release_docs: run release_docs.py with a version number to branch Google Test wiki pages for a new release
branch_wiki_files: use WikiBrancher to branch .wiki files in an SVN workspace for a specified version number
update_links_in_branched_files: update internal wiki links in branched files so they point to the versioned page names
get_files_to_branch: call GetFilesToBranch to list all .wiki files that need versioning excluding unversioned ones
drop_wiki_suffix: use DropWikiSuffix to remove the .wiki extension from a wiki filename
